_about: Per record, per field: [url, tier, quote]. Tiers are in `legend`. engines, tanks and legend are the research file research/data-drafts/field-sources.json (also SpaxeX src/data/extended/field-sources.json): engines verbatim; tanks keep the research note and figures as `_note`, `_dryToPropellant_pct`, `_passes4pct`, `_passes3pct` (keys starting with `_` are not record fields) and add per-field entries. presets, payloads (demo-only payloads.extra records) and visuals are demo additions. A field with no entry falls back to the record's `source`.
